The '''"inhibitor incident"''' was an event that occurred on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trevura]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Wizards" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I understand you've caused some stormtroopers to miss their mark today. Good shooting. I'd like to be the first to congratulate you.|S-R6, to the player characters in one of the alternate scenarios in "Gun Nut"|<ref name="Wizards" />}}
The "inhibitor incident" was created for "[[Gun Nut]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] miniadventure for the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Jeff Quick]] and published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[April 11]], [[2002]].<ref name="Wizards" />
